author: Mark Atwood
text:
Demoted: bd-spin no longer halts on human-labeled beads (fixed in JMAP-j6td), so this bead's original purpose — gating the loop on a sequencing decision — is moot. Categories A/B/C are things the autonomous loop can drive in priority order with no human input. The two real pending human decisions embedded in this bead's analysis are:

- Category D (JMAP-g7wu.5): pick parser strategy for the 5 RFC 5322 As* header-form parsers — (a) new dep [mailparse/email-encoding], (b) extend mime-tree, or (c) write from scratch.
- Category E (JMAP-9i53): updatedProperties on /changes — already tracked as its own P4 bead.

Keeping this open at P4 as a permanent record of the sequencing analysis. Human label removed so it does not gate the autonomous loop.
